title: Analyze graphify report and project workflow for code alignment and entanglement
done_items:
1. Completed deep analysis of graphify report (9270 nodes, 18667 edges, 392 communities, vendor noise vs core hubs).
2. Identified four system entanglements: God Service (BatchStudioService), frontend 12-script global state spaghetti, job planning mixed into worker pool, and dual-state desynchronization (memory vs DB).
3. Audited codebase conformance against SPEC-010 8-stage workflow (revealing gaps in phase 4 progress/quota recovery and phase 8 course deletion).
4. Formulated decoupling & streamlining blueprint (StudioBus, service triage, SSOT) in docs/architecture/WORKFLOW_AND_COUPLING_ANALYSIS.md.
